baseline_kernel: sglang-kernel FlashMLA sparse split-KV plus combine

bottleneck.evidence: Full NCU and nsys reports under profile/dsa-flashmla-kv-stock show that the fused main kernel is limited by sparse KV reads and scoreboard/barrier stalls, while combine is limited by the fixed partial-output read stream.

approaches.summary: Traced current SGLang before optimizing and pivoted from the former standalone W_UV operation to the reached flashmla_kv fused attention implementation.
approaches.why: The standalone W_UV operation is not a production replacement point and cannot establish a deployable win.

approaches.summary: Selected the combine template from a graph-safe top-k block-capacity bound instead of the device-wide scheduler-part count.
approaches.why: The change removed shared-memory bookkeeping but left partial-output traffic intact, and paired production CUDA-graph replay did not clear the promotion threshold in either bucket.

lesson: For GLM-5.2 DSA decode, treat the absorbed value path as part of the reached flashmla_kv split-KV plus combine chain. Reducing combine bookkeeping alone does not remove its partial-output traffic, and an eager micro-gain must be rejected when CUDA-graph replay is neutral.
transfers_to: fused operators whose former standalone component is unreachable
caveats: The production rank-count end-to-end gate was unavailable in this scheduler allocation.
Serving-native timing is preserved in the profile report and is intentionally not copied into knowledge result fields, which accept only persisted frozen-task result.json numbers.
